build.signingIdentity: persistent APKbox development key: androiddebugkey / CN=APKbox Development,O=mekromn,C=US

physicalDeviceEscalation: real hardware, thermal, storage, battery or radio behavior

invariants: Continuity is the controller entrypoint; APKbox repo owns implementation.
Android 16/API 36 emulator evidence precedes physical-device debugging.
The exact APK bytes tested are the exact bytes archived/delivered; SHA-256 identifies a candidate.
Branch-aware APKbox runtime traffic uses Continuity apkbox-relay, never main.
Source substitution requires exact SHA-256 proof.
Mutating/dangerous bridge operations never inherit trusted read-only/debug authority.
Unexpected foreground package blocks remote UI mutation.
Signature conflicts never silently delete user app data.
Durable jobs never blindly replay after process interruption.
Do not merge feature/screen-agent into main without explicit user authorization.

rollback.rule: Rollback uses an exact stable/LKG build with verified package/signing identity. Never cross a signing/data-loss boundary silently.

artifactResolution.rule: Use the fastest trustworthy source that proves exact SHA-256 identity; APKbox vault is one candidate, not a privileged favorite.
